# Mindmap / Research Canvas — Architecture Report

## 1. Routes + component tree

**Live route (only production canvas page):**
- `/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/src/app/(site)/research-canvas/page.tsx` L14–22  
  → `getBoundedInitialGraphData` → `StateOfDisclosureProvider` → `<MindMap />`

**Not the canvas:**
- `(site)/research/page.tsx` — writers-desk notes, not mindmap
- Ghost view pages under `features/mindmap/research-canvas/views/*` — reached via Zustand `activeView`, not own routes

**Tree:**

```
(site)/research-canvas/page.tsx
  → MindMap  [features/mindmap/mind-map.tsx L8–15]
    → ReactFlowProvider + MindMapProvider
      → ViewSwitcher  [research-canvas/ViewSwitcher.tsx L24–45]
           canvas → Graph  [features/mindmap/graph.tsx L106+]
           timeline|globe|search|detail → lazy views
  (global) layout.tsx L65 → MenuTrigger → FullScreenMenu
```

**Who renders what (in `graph.tsx` L613–723):**

| Surface | Renderer | Path |
|---|---|---|
| ReactFlow graph | `<ReactFlow>` | `graph.tsx` L620–642 |
| Empty canvas | `<EmptyCanvas>` when `isEmpty` | `graph.tsx` L661–669 → `EmptyCanvas.tsx` L63–68 |
| Chat / typer | `ResearchCanvasConsole` → `EnhancedAnimatedChat` or `MessageInput` | empty: via EmptyCanvas; populated: `graph.tsx` L711–717 → `research-canvas-console.tsx` L133–152 |
| Suggestion chips (ActionChips) | `<ActionChip>` row | `graph.tsx` L671–677 / L694–708 |
| Related-record suggestions | `<ResearchSuggestionsDock>` (non-empty only) | `graph.tsx` L721 |
| Node “inspector” | **only** `<DroppedMatchInspector>` (drop matches) | `graph.tsx` L658 — no general node inspector |
| Synthesis panel | `FloatingToolbar` → `SynthesisPanelHost` | `FloatingToolbar.tsx` L17, L88–91, L206+ |
| Tour narrative (spine) | `<TourOverlay>` | `graph.tsx` L646 |
| Floating toolbar | `<FloatingToolbar>` | `graph.tsx` L679 / L683 |

**Note:** `ViewSwitcher` no longer mounts `FullScreenMenu` (comment L44–45). Menu is global via `app/layout.tsx`. `setCommandMenuOpen(true)` (`graph.tsx` L552–554) writes store flag with **no consumer** that mounts `MindMapCommandMenu` — Search Database chip is a dead open.

---

**Re-export:** `config/index.config.ts` → imported by `graph.tsx` L9

|---|---|
| `annotationNode` | `nodes/AnnotationNode.tsx` |
| `utDroppedArtifactNode` | `nodes/dropped-artifact-node.tsx` |

| `testimoniesNode` | `nodes/testimony-node.tsx` |

| `documentNode` | `nodes/document-node.tsx` |

- Dropped artifact key is **`utDroppedArtifactNode`**, not `dropped-artifact`

## 3. Tours

### A. Spine tours on main canvas — `features/mindmap/tours/`
| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `famous-events-tour.ts` | “Modern UFO Era” def |
| `guided-tour-store.ts` | Zustand tour state |
| `use-guided-tour.ts` | Resolve waypoints → place record nodes on **same** ReactFlow |
| `tour-overlay.tsx` | Narrative HUD on canvas |

Mounted in `graph.tsx` L646: `<TourOverlay />` only.

### B. Evidence-graph tours — `features/guided-tours/`
- Shared: `TourFlowCanvas`, `TourHUD`, `WaypointInspector`, `EvidenceDrawer`, `WaypointNode`, `NarrativeEdge`, choreography, Zod schema, persistence
- Product: `nuclear-shadow/` → `NuclearShadowTour.tsx` L62 mounts **its own** `TourFlowCanvas`

**TourFlowCanvas = second ReactFlow?** **Yes.** Own `ReactFlowProvider` + `<ReactFlow>` (`TourFlowCanvas.tsx` L33–38, L100–121). Not the mindmap graph.

**TourHUD / WaypointInspector / EvidenceDrawer in `graph.tsx`?** **No.** Only in `TourFlowCanvas.tsx` L123–125.

**`/tours/nuclear-shadow`?** **Yes.**  
`app/(site)/tours/nuclear-shadow/page.tsx` L11–16 → `<NuclearShadowTour />`  
Launched from canvas chips: `graph.tsx` L537–538 `router.push('/tours/nuclear-shadow')`.

## 7. Styling

**Token systems:**
- Live canvas chrome: **`--ut-*`** in `research-canvas/canvas-animations.css` L12–20 (`--ut-void`, `--ut-surface`, `--ut-paper`, `--ut-stamp`, …)
- Drop UI: `drop/canvas-drop.css` + `--ut-*`
- Nuclear Shadow: `nuclear-shadow-tour.css` + same font vars
- **`--du-*` (@repo/disclosure-ui): 0 matches** in mindmap / guided-tours / research-canvas feature / research-ui

**Patterns:**
- Tailwind utility classes dominant (`zinc-*`, `neutral-*`, `bg-black/80`, `text-blue-400`)
- Mix: `--ut-*` on toolbar/dock/synthesis vs Tailwind zinc/blue on EmptyCanvas + EnhancedAnimatedChat
- Fonts: `--font-martian-mono`, `--font-special-elite`, `--font-jetbrains-mono` (canvas CSS); Nuclear Shadow also falls back to Georgia
